acceptance_tests: Preference payload never becomes market data
Mutating tool is excluded from read-only intake
account_and_workspace.consumer: User account UI only; excluded from empirical intake.
account_and_workspace.limits: settings_update changes user preferences; explicit need required before invoking; connection does not provide API keys.

acceptance_tests: No market-row count from prose
No research evidence from example data
api_and_education.consumer: Engineering contract documentation; excluded from empirical market intake.
api_and_education.limits: Examples and knowledge answers do not establish provider entitlement, history depth or profitable edge.
api_and_education.point_in_time: Documentation retrieval clock only; not market observation time.
api_and_education.scope: Official API schemas, support and methodology; useful for transport and entitlement understanding.

acceptance_tests: Pair/venue ambiguity cannot create exchange-qualified replay
Whale print not treated as wallet identity
crypto.limits: Venue/pair/quote-currency basis and aggregation must be preserved; whale label does not prove owner or motive.
crypto.point_in_time: UTC/venue bar and actual availability clocks required.
crypto.scope: Crypto pair bars/state and large-trade observations.

acceptance_tests: TRF context never relabeled instantaneous exchange trade
Aggregation not counted as independent individual prints
dark_and_lit_stock_flow.limits: Reporting delays/corrections and aggregation semantics require verification; prints do not identify intent or accumulation.
dark_and_lit_stock_flow.point_in_time: Keep trade time distinct from report/availability time; retrieval alone permits current context only.
dark_and_lit_stock_flow.scope: Off-exchange/TRF and lit stock prints plus per-price concentration.

acceptance_tests: Future calendar event not treated as realized result
Transcript text not redistributed in public receipts
earnings_and_analysts.consumer: Event context and textual research reference learning events.
earnings_and_analysts.limits: Ratings are opinions; estimates, actuals and revised transcripts have different availability; narrative is not a numeric observation.
earnings_and_analysts.point_in_time: Separate announced time, actual release time and revised/received time.
earnings_and_analysts.scope: Analyst actions, earnings outcomes, transcripts and expected event context.

acceptance_tests: Period end never substituted for available_at
Units/currency remain unknown unless explicit
financial_statements.limits: Restatements, units/currency, period basis and filing timestamps need verification; statement period end is not public availability.
financial_statements.point_in_time: Require filing publication and version/revision timestamps for historical joins.
financial_statements.scope: Filing-based balance sheet, income and cash-flow facts and screens.

acceptance_tests: Estimated exposure labeled provider-derived
Chart output not silently treated as numerical source rows
greek_exposure_and_flow.consumer: Descriptive options regime learning events; future exposure corroboration experiment inputs.
greek_exposure_and_flow.limits: Model/position assumptions and units require source-specific verification; GEX does not establish dealer inventory or actual hedging.
greek_exposure_and_flow.point_in_time: Snapshot/model generation and availability must be known before any causal replay.
greek_exposure_and_flow.scope: Greek exposure and flow, gamma levels and strike/expiry views.

acceptance_tests: Resolved identity kept separate from observed price
Ambiguous identity does not create tradable instrument
identity_resolution.consumer: Intake symbol/contract identity checks; descriptive research reference.
identity_resolution.limits: Ticker identity is not exchange-qualified history coverage; compact OCC resolution does not certify contract prices.
identity_resolution.point_in_time: Reference metadata uses retrieval clock until source publication and revision times are supplied.

acceptance_tests: Disclosure lag blocks pre-filing reuse
Institution identity not treated as current position
insider_and_institutional.limits: Disclosure lag, amendments and holdings-period semantics matter; filed holdings do not establish current holdings or insider intent.
insider_and_institutional.point_in_time: Use filing/acceptance availability; transaction or quarter date is insufficient.
insider_and_institutional.scope: SEC insider and 13F institution/ownership filings and aggregates.

acceptance_tests: Curve observation date does not prove publication time
Revision unknown prevents historical as-of certification
macro_and_calendar.consumer: Macro context learning events and event-time diagnostics.
macro_and_calendar.limits: Historical revisions and release schedules need explicit vintage; event calendar is expected future context.
macro_and_calendar.point_in_time: Observation date, publication time, vintage and retrieval remain separate.
macro_and_calendar.scope: Policy rates, Treasury curve and economic/event calendar.

acceptance_tests: Aggregates do not multiply independent evidence
Rendered chart stays presentation-only absent source values
market_and_sector_regime.consumer: Research regime learning events; scenario context.
market_and_sector_regime.limits: Weighted/aggregated views share source ancestry; rendered charts may lack machine-readable data; screen results are selection-biased.
market_and_sector_regime.point_in_time: Daily/trading-day labels need market timezone and as-of availability before historical reuse.
market_and_sector_regime.scope: Market, ETF and sector options/price regime snapshots and cross-sectional screens.

acceptance_tests: Contract/expiry dimensions preserved in sanitized request identity
Snapshot is not converted to OHLC training bars
option_contracts_and_screeners.consumer: Hash-bound option context learning events; future separately qualified contract replay.
option_contracts_and_screeners.limits: Chain snapshot is not executed-price history; stance rankings do not prove a recommendation; entitlement and pagination remain unknown per request.
option_contracts_and_screeners.point_in_time: Require source timestamp and availability timestamp before temporal joins; historical date by itself is insufficient.
option_contracts_and_screeners.scope: Contract identity, chain snapshots, daily option histories and mechanically ranked screening.

acceptance_tests: Unknown clock prevents historical eligibility
Duplicate payload does not multiply independent evidence
options_flow.consumer: Research flow observation learning events and source coverage diagnostics.
options_flow.limits: Side and multi-leg labels are provider classifications; prints do not establish beneficial owner or future direction; event tape can be partial.
options_flow.point_in_time: Retain trade/report/received times separately; OI publication date is not trade time.
options_flow.scope: Individual prints, unusual alerts, multi-leg reconstruction, expiry/strike flow and OI behavior.

acceptance_tests: Trade occurrence not substituted for disclosure availability
Unverified allegation never promoted to fact
politics_and_public_activity.limits: Disclosure delays and reported ranges remain explicit; social activity or congressional trades do not imply causal effect.
politics_and_public_activity.point_in_time: Separate occurrence, disclosure/publication and retrieval clocks.
politics_and_public_activity.scope: Congressional disclosure summaries, election context and public schedule/social activity.

acceptance_tests: Screen classification remains provider-derived
Prediction probability is not empirical frequency or execution authorization
prediction_markets.limits: Market rules, resolution/fees/spread, leaderboard selection and identity assertions need explicit validation; insider labels are hypotheses.
prediction_markets.point_in_time: Quote/order-book retrieval and source clock, market resolution definition and cutoff must be separate.
prediction_markets.scope: Prediction-market detail, order-book liquidity and provider-classified trader/activity screens.

acceptance_tests: Close-only source rejected as OHLC
Future or missing source/availability time does not receive temporal eligibility
prices_and_technicals.consumer: Descriptive learning events; qualified OHLC loader remains separate and unchanged.
prices_and_technicals.limits: Close-only rows cannot enter OHLC trainers; indicators are derived data; vendor adjustment/volume/venue/timeframe semantics remain explicit gaps.
prices_and_technicals.point_in_time: Bar close/availability clocks and timezone are necessary; never infer PIT from retrieval or date alone.
prices_and_technicals.scope: Price bars, closes, derived indicators and exchange trading-state context.

acceptance_tests: Current historical estimate not admitted as old as-of fact
Unknown sample denominator stays unknown
seasonality_and_relationships.limits: Current historical estimates can include revised data and selection/look-ahead bias; correlation is not causation or out-of-sample edge.
seasonality_and_relationships.point_in_time: Sample window and estimator generation need versioning for causal replay.
seasonality_and_relationships.scope: Historical seasonal statistics, monthly returns and pairwise correlations.

acceptance_tests: Short-volume metric kept distinct from short interest
Missing denominator yields incomplete context
short_interest_and_borrow.consumer: Positioning and liquidity descriptive learning events.
short_interest_and_borrow.limits: Short volume is not short interest; borrow quotes are source-specific and may be stale; denominator/venue coverage matters.
short_interest_and_borrow.point_in_time: Publication lag and quote timestamp necessary for historical reuse.
short_interest_and_borrow.scope: Borrow availability/rates, reported short interest and short-volume context.

acceptance_tests: Expiry preserved
Calculated level never treated as realized outcome
volatility_and_expiry.limits: Max pain is a calculated statistic, not a price forecast; IV methodology and underlying reference must be retained.
volatility_and_expiry.point_in_time: Need source snapshot and retrieval availability; expiry is a dimension, not observation time.
volatility_and_expiry.scope: IV term structure and expiry-specific max-pain calculations.

rights.default: Private observation metadata only until explicit rights are verified.

runtime_boundary: A ChatGPT connector is not repository API credentials, a paid budget or a unattended scheduler transport.
scope: Public-safe connector capability inventory; no raw responses, account settings, credentials or storage identities.
